label: Fix remaining memory-core migration issues in turso-adapter worktree
summary: Migrated extensions.ts (9 functions + 1 helper) and fixed enrich-batch.ts autocall from raw Database.Database to StoreAdapter in the turso-adapter worktree

changes.kind: Fixed buildAutoLinks call: changed from sync db param to awaited adapter param (line 253)

Migrated ALL functions from Database.Database to StoreAdapter: detectPromotionCandidates, proposePendingCandidates, applyPromotion (two adapters), rejectPromotion, getPromotionQueue, graphifyImport, buildCommunities, memoryGetCommunity, memorySearchEntities + helper _writePromotionQueueApplied. Replaced import Database with StoreAdapter/AdapterTransaction types. All db.prepare().get/all/run() → adapter.executeGet/All/Run(). db.transaction() → adapter.transaction(). Sync functions made async with Promise return types.

build.note: tsc --project libs/memory-core/tsconfig.lib.json --noEmit: zero errors. nx build memory-core blocked by pre-existing dependency failures in hybrid-search:build and analysis:build (unrelated async/await migration issues).

tests.note: ALL 258 failures are pre-existing in the turso-adapter worktree (tests pass raw Database objects to functions already expecting StoreAdapter, e.g. cluster.spec.ts, quota.spec.ts, compaction.spec.ts, extensions.spec.ts). The extensions.spec.ts tests fail because the test helper seedEpisode() still uses db.prepare() against a StoreAdapter. These are NOT regressions from this change — TypeScript compilation of the changed files is clean.

issues: Pre-existing: cluster-subset.spec.ts fails with 'adapter.executeAll is not a function' — tests pass raw Database objects to functions expecting StoreAdapter
Pre-existing: quota.spec.ts fai1s with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading dbPath)' — tests pass incomplete mock objects
Pre-existing: compaction.spec.ts same adapter.config.dbPath undefined issue

handoff_notes: Callers of the migrated extensions.ts functions (memory-server/src/index.ts, memory-flush/src/index.ts) still pass Database.Database objects — they need separate migration to pass StoreAdapter or use wrapRawDbAsAdapter()
The extensions.spec.ts test file needs migration: seedEpisode() must use adapter.executeRun() instead of db.prepare(), and db.close() → await adapter.close()
enrich.spec.ts runBatchEnrich tests need await on async calls (pre-existing — runBatchEnrich was already async before this change)
